summary: Six new isolated failures emerged across individual tools, including unexpected test outputs in spades and mfassignr_mfassignCHO as well as job errors in tools like bamtools_split_mapped and rseqc_clipping_profile. The shared infrastructure issue regarding unavailable server test input data persists across 6 tools and 10 tests, while other continuing tool issues remain stable with no action needed. A previous output failure for mfassignr_mfassignCHO has recovered.
